kind: PROPOSED FULL ASSIGNMENT-TIMESTAMP CHECK, NO REQUEST AUTHORIZATION

population.rule: Union of differing candidate first-registered-close choices,UTCcalendar-month choices,monthly formation-eligibility changes,and entire uncertain latest-signal competitor contexts;plus the108exclusive winter/summer clock-disagreement pool.
population.reason: Joint monthly competitors are included,not just possible winners. UTCmonth choices are conservatively retained even if the next close is same.
population.not_in_scope: Records sensitive only to prior120/future365label windows,not the requested trading-day/month decisions,are not automatically included.
population.exclusion_warning: The mandated108are the priority-exclusive37winter+71summer pools,not all165raw disagreements. Outside records are NOT certified; expanding scope requires an explicit amended population and budget.
population.control_handling: Retain these already-cached conditional counterexamples as controls,not population members or newly fetched cases;insensitivity is not clock authority.

URLs_and_cache.identity_policy: Header and index for EACH distinct original pair/bulkCIK archive path per accession;no firstCIK/accession-prefix remap. Content identity/role conflicts remain unresolved,not cache-deduplicated away.
URLs_and_cache.cache_definition: Checksum-pinned,bounded<64KiB,parseable header/index metadata. This is collection reuse,NOT clock or issuer certification.

proposed_approval.budget_contract: Count all attempts before sending;cache hits0. Exact docs allowlist,population+URLinventory+sourcepins frozen before network;unused document budget does not transfer to extra filings. This proposal changes no ceiling or counter.

time.wall_note: 2starts/s is an upper rate,not assured throughput;serial latency and fail-stop rules can prevent completion.12h is proposed approval,not permission. Stop/checkpoint at wall,no automatic retry or scope expansion.
time.rate_source: Owner dispatch supplies published SEC ceiling10/s;existingproject protocol also cites it. Not refreshed over network in this offline plan;the proposedclient remains at2/s.

storage.policy: Private ignored raw metadata+hashes+append-only receipts;never financial bodies/quotes/identities in Git. Compression benefit not assumed. Cap/space failure stops or leaves explicit unknown,no silent deletion/truncation.

prerequisites_and_stops.clock_authority: Stage1 page did not define historical acceptance clocks. First qualify applicable header/index/API/bulk field definitions. If unsupported,stop with conditional Eastern candidates only;do not call them verifiedUTC.
prerequisites_and_stops.calendar: Current risk flags use cached French dates/nominal16:00ET,not independently certified venue/early-close calendar. Qualify relevant calendar before claiming actual exchange-session assignment changes;otherwise label registered-calendar only.
prerequisites_and_stops.identity: Role-aware filer/subject/transmitter/co-registrant evidence;multipleCIKs are not issuer/security mapping. Preserve original identities and uncertainty.
prerequisites_and_stops.sealed_data: Only already-used acceptance/role/indexmetadata dates;no statement/XBRL,fundamental outcome,prices/returns or sealed observations. Stop scope uncertainty.
prerequisites_and_stops.http: Existing declared User-Agent,ordinary publicHTTPS,<=2/s,serial,30stotal,no retries/redirects. Stop whole acquisition on403/429/5xx/transport/redirect/budget/scope/integrity/wall failure. No alternate identity/proxy/CIK bypass.
prerequisites_and_stops.unknowns: Oversized/missing/malformed/ambiguous civil clock/role/conflict stays unknown,never agreement. Knownunusable cache is not proof another GET will help;freshfetchatmostonce onlyifapproved,stillbounded. Unresolved rows block certification.
prerequisites_and_stops.screen_violation: If a qualified instant falls outside the frozen one-offset candidate envelope,stop certification and re-plan the population;do not assume excluded records remain assignment-insensitive or expand requests automatically.

done_output.per_accession: Every required accession accounted for with original clocks/identities,resource/version/retrievalhashes,documented applicable clock basis,unique qualifiedUTC instant or explicit unresolved reason,and role/calendar status.
done_output.assignment_reconciliation: Using qualified times and the frozen rules,compare originalvsverified first close,UTC/month buckets,monthly eligibility and latest-signalchoice;report exact accession counts,record-month instances and firm-month changes.No scores,prices,portfolio weights or P&L required.
done_output.acceptance: Verified means clock definition applicable,identityrole resolved,civil conversion unique,sourceconflicts addressed and calendar qualified. A list of conditional Eastern conversions alone is NOT done. Report verified/unresolved/unread/conflicting coverage with full reconciliation,not a blanket offset.
done_output.separate_decisions: No production timestamp/CIK repair,correction release,publicationor backtest rerun without another decision,even after the audit is complete.
done_output.limit: This certifies only explicitly verified plan members,not the excluded cohortor allfilings;one-offset sensitivity screen is not a probability or global error bound.
